title: Seestar AstroLab AAVSO: ZWO Seestar to AAVSO Extended Photometry Converter & Urgent Target Radar
description: Open-source Windows desktop application for ZWO Seestar (S30, S30PRO, S50, S50PRO) citizen-science variable-star photometry. Converts raw Seestar Magnitude_*.csv files into verified AAVSO Extended WebObs reports with J2000.0 SIMBAD/VSX coordinate cross-checking, canonical STARID normalization, per-row MERR and low-altitude/airmass (Kasten-Young) quality guards, automatic deduplication, dual interactive AAVSO AID light curves, and a 246-target urgent AAVSO radar.
